correctness.rationale: For every n>=2, K>1 and alpha in [0,1], the proof explicitly establishes all directed EF1 comparisons, online information restrictions, upper bounds on short/long successes, an attaining deterministic response for each prior, and the exact equality conditions for the unique least-favourable distribution. Independent exact-rational brute-force enumeration of 90 small weighted policy games and 280 equalizer cases matched the analytic predictions. Finite tests do not replace the unbounded proof.

value.rationale: It resolves the natural diagnostic of whether the EF1 upper-bound certificate is itself optimally weighted and exactly tight as a game: a complete formula for every adversarial prior, uniqueness of the hard distribution, equalization over each input, and a sharp alpha threshold. Hence no reweighting of the existing 2n witnesses can improve the published probabilistic obstruction; a stronger global lower bound needs structurally new input families. This is a motivated complete exact invariant, not merely a restated upper bound or arbitrary finite census.
